name: HearMandarin HSK 3.0 Word List Dataset
source: Official 2025 HSK 3.0 exam syllabus word list and the 2015 HSK 2.0 word list. See https://hearmandarin.com/data-sources/ for exact file names and dates.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable word id used across the site (e.g. w00001).

fields.name: hsk3_band
fields.description: HSK 3.0 band, 1 to 7 (7 means bands 7 to 9, which the syllabus does not split). Empty for words that are only in HSK 2.0.

fields.name: hsk3_seq
fields.description: Sequence number inside its HSK 3.0 band, per the official syllabus order. Empty for words that are only in HSK 2.0.

fields.name: hsk2_level
fields.description: HSK 2.0 level, 1 to 6. Empty for words that are not in the 2.0 list.

fields.name: pos_zh
fields.description: Part of speech as given by the official list, in Chinese. A word can carry more than one, separated by 、.

fields.name: pos_en
fields.description: Part of speech in English, mapped from pos_zh. Multiple values are joined with "; ".

fields.name: gloss_en
fields.description: Short teaching gloss in English, written or reviewed in-house. Not the CC-CEDICT dictionary text.
